question: Name one feature added in the latest Autodesk Fusion update.
answer:
Based on Autodesk Fusion's October 2026 major update (v.2706.1.14, October 21, 2026), with the latest minor update being v.2706.1.17 from October 28, 2026 [1].

One feature added is Auto Timeline, which uses AI-assisted feature reconstruction to convert imported, non-native geometry into an editable parametric Fusion design [3]. It currently reconstructs extrudes, revolves, chamfers, fillets, holes and basic sweeps, and it is built for quick model adjustments rather than full rebuilds [3]. The same update also added a no-code, node-based System Modeler and built-in task management [3].

keyPoints.text: The latest major update is the October 2026 Fusion update, which adds Auto Timeline for imported models, System Modeler, turning improvements, eCAD drill and copper views, and built-in task management.
Auto Timeline uses AI-assisted feature reconstruction to convert imported non-native geometry into an editable parametric Fusion design.
Autodesk Assistant can now use Fusion error and warning information when asked for help, and chats can be renamed and pinned.
Revision History tables in Drawings can now automatically update Zone and Sheet information.
The most recent minor update is v.2706.1.17 dated October 28, 2026.

The Apple silicon requirement for Macs starts at the end of March 2027, so the Intel Mac guidance is a future change rather than a current one.
